tasks.title: Rating packs (Smart Packs + country layer): externalise crop/base/deductible ratings from enums into loader-validated YAML rating packs via RatingPackService; enums become catalog keys; add default + PL override pack; fail-fast on invalid packs; wire PremiumCalculator/quote through the service; add RatingPackServiceTest
tasks.acceptance_prose: Externalise all rating values (CropType base rates + risk categories, Bundesland risk factors, Deductible premium factors) into YAML rating packs under src/main/resources/rating/ (default.yml + one override pack, e.g. pl.yml). Add RatingPackService that loads+validates packs at startup (unknown key or non-positive value => fail fast) and exposes lookups (baseRateFor/riskFactorFor/premiumFactorFor with country override). Enums keep only identifiers and names, no numeric ratings. PremiumCalculator and quote flow resolve values through RatingPackService (default country DE). Add RatingPackServiceTest: default lookup, invalid pack fails startup, country override wins. All existing tests stay green.

tasks.title: Policy/Billing/Claims module boundaries: introduce com.example.cropguard.modules.{policy,billing,claims} housing module-owned service/repo logic (billing = premium/quote), controllers delegate into modules, layer mapping preserved; add ModuleBoundaryTest asserting no cross-module repository/entity access except explicit allowance
tasks.acceptance_prose: Refactor the core into modules policy, billing (premium/quote), claims under com.example.cropguard.modules.*; controllers stay in the controller layer and delegate into the modules so the controller->service->repository layer mapping of the course spec remains recognisable. Add an architectural ModuleBoundaryTest that inspects service+repository classes of the three modules and fails when one module directly references another module's repositories/entities, unless the access pattern is an explicit allowance (facade/port) listed in the test. Behaviour must be identical: POST /api/policies/quote, POST /api/claims, PUT /api/claims/{id}/assess keep their status codes and payloads. All existing tests stay green.

tasks.title: OpenAPI as published tested contract (ACE pattern): springdoc serves versioned GET /v3/api-docs (OpenAPI 3, info.version from build), module tags; add OpenApiContractTest verifying core paths /api/policies,/api/claims,/api/plots and openapi 3.x
tasks.acceptance_prose: Ensure springdoc serves a versioned GET /v3/api-docs returning OpenAPI 3 with info.version derived from the build version, and add module-level API tags (policy/billing/claims). Add OpenApiContractTest (Spring MockMvc against the real context) asserting the document is application/json with openapi: 3.x and contains /api/policies, /api/claims, /api/plots. Do not touch README (owned by SA-5). All tests stay green.

tasks.title: Legacy data import with validation report: config-gated (cropguard.legacy-import.enabled, default off) CommandLineRunner reads committed legacy CSV fixture, validates each record, maps valid rows to rating data, reports per-record failures, startup continues; LegacyImportServiceTest
tasks.acceptance_prose: Add src/main/resources/legacy/ratings_legacy.csv as a legacy fixture (crop, base_rate, risk, bundesland_factor, deductible_percent, deductible_factor; includes a few deliberately invalid rows). Add LegacyImportService with parse+validate+map logic: valid rows apply to rating-pack data, invalid rows (unknown/empty/negative) are collected into a per-record failure report with the reason; the import never aborts startup on invalid rows. Gate it behind cropguard.legacy-import.enabled (default false) as a CommandLineRunner (no new role/endpoint). Add LegacyImportServiceTest for happy path + invalid-row reporting. All tests stay green.
